carta-home-build.headline: What's new on Carta Home describes each featured skill by what you get from it.

carta-soi.headline: SOI now has an Investment Cash Flows tab: every dated investment, proceed and terminal value behind Deal IRR, grouped by company and fund, following the same fund, as-of and exited filters.

carta-workhub-build.headline: Workhub now groups your tasks the way the Firm Dash does, and files each request to Carta under what it is about.
